statement0:
The word "little" is mentioned in 1.8% of papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "little" , 27.0% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This rate is similar to median Psychology paper (shown in black); relative to other words, papers with "little" are in the top 55th percentile of fragile p-value percentages. Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "little" tend to be published in higher impact factor journals (68th percentile among all words) and tend to be cited more (70th percentile word). In general, this word is negatively associated with university ranking, such that higher-ranked institutions are less likely to publish papers containing "little" (41st percentile).
